answer: Every claim climbs the summit of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the pigment re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, no identity may audit its own recruit. What survives to the zenith is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
